headword: {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}
gloss: gold, silver, and treasure; riches and valuables

definitions.gloss: gold, silver, and treasure; riches and valuables
definitions.explanation: A collective term for precious metals and treasures, evoking the image of a great hoard of wealth.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海賊|かいぞく}→海賊：13288_kaizoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}した→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧。
examples.english: The pirates hid their gold and treasure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{洞窟|どうくつ}→洞窟：05038_doukutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{奥|おく}→奥：00980_oku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}っている→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧⟦という→という：09577_toiu⟧⟦{伝説|でんせつ}→伝説：11446_densetsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Legend has it that gold and treasure lie sleeping deep within the cave.

examples.japanese: ⟦{戦国|せんごく}{時代|じだい}→戦国時代：19200_sengokujidai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武将|ぶしょう}→武将：13222_bushou⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{集|あつ}め→集める：01170_atsumeru⟧、⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{蓄|たくわ}えていた→蓄える：08996_takuwaeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: It is said that the warlords of the Sengoku period collected gold, silver, and treasure and stored them in their castles.

notes:
A four-character compound (⟦{四字|よじ}{熟語|じゅくご}→四字熟語：15663_yojijukugo⟧) combining {金銀|きんぎん} (gold and silver) + ⟦{財宝|ざいほう}→財宝：18496_zaihou⟧ (treasure; valuables). Evokes a literary or fairy-tale image of glittering riches. Commonly appears in stories about pirates, buried treasure, ancient kingdoms, and historical wealth.

- {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{隠|かく}す→隠す：02034_kakusu⟧: to hide treasure
- {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{眠|ねむ}る→眠る：01181_nemuru⟧: treasure lies buried
- {金銀|きんぎん}{財宝|ざいほう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧くらむ: to be blinded by treasure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{財宝|ざいほう}→財宝：18496_zaihou⟧: treasure; valuables — the general term for valuable possessions
- ⟦{宝物|たからもの}→宝物：12269_takaramono⟧: treasure; prized possession — can refer to sentimental value, not just monetary
- ⟦{富|とみ}→富：12321_tomi⟧: wealth; riches — abstract concept of being wealthy
